# API index

<!-- Generated by .github/scripts/api_index.py from the installed package. Do
not edit: run the script, which `--check` holds the page to. -->

Every public name of the Python package, one table per module: what it is, the
first sentence of its docstring, and the section of these pages that documents
it. A name exported by more than one module is listed under each. The full
signatures are in the docstrings (`help(name)`), and `medh5._core` is the
compiled extension the modules re-export from, not an API of its own.

| `write_itk_transform` | function | Write *transform* as ITK reads it, picking the format by suffix: `.tfm` or `.txt` text, ITK's HDF5 (`.h5`, `.hdf5`, `.hdf`), or `.mat` as ANTs writes it. | [Converters › ITK transforms](converters.md#itk-transforms) |
